decisive_items: Dermal tumor infiltrating the subcutaneous fat without epidermal involvement
Tumor cells arrayed in an Indian-file pattern between collagen bundles
Diffuse infiltration of apocrine glands in close apposition to the tumor
response.rationale: The triad of a pilar-skinned tumor with an Indian-file pattern and an apocrine/IHC profile is pathognomonic for extramammary Paget disease; no other diagnostic entity aligns across all features.
